# Northlight

> Northlight Advisory Services is a Canadian strategy, advisory, AI adoption, and app development practice founded by Elizabeth Lemoine. Based in Nova Scotia, Canada. Remote-first.

Northlight helps business leaders, founders, and operations heads at small-to-mid-sized Canadian organisations think more clearly, make better decisions, and use technology intelligently. The tagline is: Clear thinking. Real results.

## About

- Founder and Principal: Elizabeth Lemoine
- Location: Nova Scotia, Canada
- Website: https://bynorthlight.ca
- Contact: elizabeth@bynorthlight.ca
- LinkedIn (personal): https://www.linkedin.com/in/elizabethannelemoine
- LinkedIn (company): https://www.linkedin.com/company/bynorthlight
- Threads: https://www.threads.com/@northlightcomms

Elizabeth Lemoine is a strategist and operations leader with over a decade of director-level experience across nonprofit, tech, and global organisations. She founded Northlight to provide direct, practical advisory work to organisations navigating real decisions.

## Services

### Strategy
Helping organisations identify what actually matters, set clear direction, and build plans that hold up under pressure. Not strategy documents — decision clarity.

### Advisory & Fractional Leadership
Ongoing thinking partnership for founders and operators. Includes fractional engagements where Elizabeth works as an embedded part of a team for a defined period. Director-level operations and strategy capacity without a full-time hire.

### AI Adoption
Practical AI implementation for Canadian businesses. Identifying which workflows AI improves, which tools fit, and what governance is needed. Grounded in Canadian regulatory context including PIPEDA, the OPC's ChatGPT investigation findings, and the BDC LIFT program.

### Apps
Building small, purposeful tools that solve real workflow problems. Current product: Northlight Vault. App development also offered as a client service.

## Products

### Northlight Vault
A free Windows desktop application that lets users browse files across Google Drive, OneDrive, and Dropbox in a single interface. Read-only by design — it finds and opens files, it does not move, edit, or delete them. No account required. No data collected beyond aggregate anonymous analytics via Plausible. Free during early access.
URL: https://bynorthlight.ca/vault.html
Download: available at https://bynorthlight.ca/vault.html

## What Northlight is not
- A platform vendor
- A framework factory
- A large consulting firm
- A technology evangelist
- Competing with big four firms — working with clients they don't serve

## Target clients
Business leaders, founders, and operations heads at small-to-mid-sized organisations (typically under 50 people) navigating growth, change, or technology adoption. Canadian market primary. Intelligent, time-poor, skeptical of hype. Have often been burned by consultants who produced reports but no results.
